channel.title: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast
channel.description:
Dan and Patrick's daily antidote to doomscrolling: two or three genuinely good developments in science and tech with sources, honest disagreement about what they mean, and one concrete action with real numbers on its impact — The Lever. Plus the Do Positive Dispatch: what listeners actually did. Do something about it.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.
